claims: Leonardo DiCaprio has won one Academy Award out of six acting nominations.
Leonardo DiCaprio won Best Actor for his role as Hugh Glass in The Revenant (2015).
Leonardo DiCaprio won Best Actor at the 88th Academy Awards.
Leonardo DiCaprio's win for The Revenant marked his first Oscar win.
Leonardo DiCaprio was nominated for Supporting Actor for What's Eating Gilbert Grape (1994).
Leonardo DiCaprio was nominated for Actor for The Aviator (2005).
Leonardo DiCaprio was nominated for Actor for Blood Diamond (2007).
Leonardo DiCaprio was nominated for Actor for The Wolf of Wall Street (2014).
Leonardo DiCaprio was nominated for Actor for Once Upon a Time... in Hollywood (2020).
Leonardo DiCaprio was nominated for Best Picture as a producer for The Wolf of Wall Street.
